18	SERIES = "#2a78d6"
19	SURFACE = "#fcfcfb"
20	INK = "#0b0b0b"

27	def learning_curve(
28	    runs: Sequence[Run], baselines: BaselineMeans, out: Path, *, measure: str | None = None
29	) -> Output:
30	    check_same_settings(runs)
31	    figure = draw_curves(runs, baselines, measure)
32	    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
33	    figure.savefig(out)
34	    figure.savefig(out.with_suffix(".svg"))

38	def draw_curves(runs: Sequence[Run], baselines: BaselineMeans, measure: str | None) -> Figure:
39	    """One panel per team (or one for `measure`): mean line, min-max band, baseline lines."""
40	    if not runs:
41	        raise ValueError("no runs to chart")
42	    spec = runs[0].record.spec
43	    panels = _panels(spec, measure)
44	    figure = Figure(figsize=(6.4 * len(panels), 4.2), facecolor=SURFACE, layout="constrained")
45	    axes = figure.subplots(1, len(panels), squeeze=False)[0]
46	    for ax, (team, label) in zip(axes, panels, strict=True):
47	        steps, values = _series(runs, team, measure)
48	        _draw_band(ax, steps, values, _title(team, label, len(runs)))
49	        if measure is None:
50	            _draw_baselines(ax, baselines, team)
51	        _style(ax, label)
52	    return figure

55	def _title(team: str, label: str, count: int) -> str:
56	    """The panel title with the run count; under MIN_BAND_RUNS runs, a note on the band."""
57	    title = f"{team}: {label}, {count} runs"
58	    if count < MIN_BAND_RUNS:
59	        return f"{title}\nmin-max band not meaningful with under {MIN_BAND_RUNS} runs"
60	    return title

63	def _panels(spec: WorldSpec, measure: str | None) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
64	    """(team, y-axis label) per panel: each team's score, or the declared measure's team."""
65	    if measure is None:
66	        return [(team.name, team.score_name) for team in spec.teams]
67	    declared = [m for m in spec.measures if m.name == measure]
68	    if not declared:
69	        raise ValueError(f"{spec.world} declares no measure {measure!r}")
70	    return [(declared[0].team, measure)]

73	def _series(
74	    runs: Sequence[Run], team: str, measure: str | None
75	) -> tuple[NDArray[np.int64], NDArray[np.float64]]:
76	    """The evaluation steps every run has, and each run's value there (runs x steps)."""
77	    by_run = [
78	        {p.step: p.scores[team] if measure is None else p.measures[measure] for p in run.evals()}
79	        for run in runs
80	    ]
81	    steps = sorted(set.intersection(*(set(values) for values in by_run)))
82	    rows = [[values[step] for step in steps] for values in by_run]
83	    return np.array(steps, dtype=np.int64), np.array(rows, dtype=np.float64)

87	    ax.fill_between(

105	    )
